Name: leash mod
Author: peter322930
Description:
Lead Any Creature (Minecraft-style Lead for Stardew Valley)
Ever wanted to lead your farm animals around or keep a unique monster as a pet at home? Inspired by Minecraft's lead mechanics, this mod introduces a craftable Lead to Stardew Valley, allowing you to tether and guide almost any creature!
Features
* Cheap Recipe: Craft a Lead easily using just 2 Wood.
* Lead Animals & Pets: Right-click on any farm animal or pet with the lead in hand to guide them wherever you go—even straight into your farmhouse.
* Tether to Fences: Right-click a fence while holding a leashed creature to tie them to the post.
* Easy Retrieval: Hit the fence post with an Axe to detach the leash and collect your lead back.
* Tether Monsters: Works on monsters too! Right-click monsters in the mines to leash them and bring them back up to the surface. Want a pet Serpent flying in your yard? Now you can!
* Universal Compatibility: Works on virtually all animals and monsters.
* Config Support: Fully supports Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) to customize settings and details to your liking.
Requirements
* SMAPI
* (Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) for in-game configuration.
